items.text: All 8 decisions from rounds 1 and 2 (UI page structure, CLI nesting, gate output format, approval decide UX, automated testing strategy, data freshness, gate badge placement, required-platforms component style) were selected as option A and have been fully incorporated into plan.md. No remaining gaps or open unknowns.

Readiness is 3/3 across all dimensions. Problem is fully understood (existing backend with zero CLI/UI coverage). Scope is well-defined with acceptance_allow globs covering api/ui/cli/docs and explicit out-of-scope items. Approach is a detailed 6-phase plan with command mapping tables, component designs, and file-level references. Testing plan specifies per-subcommand CLI tests (httptest.NewServer, table-driven) and per-component UI tests (Vitest + RTL). Risk matrix covers 5 identified risks with mitigations.

The plan is execution-ready. All contract decisions are settled in Section 8. The 13 mandatory plan sections are fully populated with no TBD placeholders. The item can be moved to ready/queued status.

plan_updates: No substantive changes needed — plan.md was already fully up-to-date with all round 2 decisions when this finalize pass ran. Verified internal consistency across all 13 sections.
